findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while a search query is active
findings.description: The new `HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES` filter sits after the early return `if (!searchQuery.trim()) return sorted;`. With an empty search box (the default), `is_segment`, `project_id` and `received` are still rendered. They disappear only once the user types something. Apply the hidden-attribute filter before the search-query branch.

findings.title: Error events are merged with replay events using mismatched timestamp units
findings.description: `gen_request_data` compares `error_events[i]["timestamp"]` with `event.get("timestamp", 0)`. Error timestamps come straight from nodestore (`data.get("timestamp", 0.0)`, line 115), which is epoch seconds. Recording-segment (rrweb) events normally carry epoch milliseconds — this is from knowledge of the format, not confirmed in this repo. If so, every error sorts before the first replay event instead of being interleaved, and the log lines mix units. The new tests use seconds for both sides (`float(now.timestamp())`, and `1.5`/`2.0`/`3.0`), so they would not catch it. Normalise to one unit in `fetch_error_details`.

findings.title: `fetch_error_details` pairs IDs with nodestore results by position
findings.description: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes `get_multi` returns values in input order. `NodeStorage.get_multi` (`src/sentry/nodestore/base.py:174-210`) dedupes IDs and, on a partial cache hit, returns uncached items first and then merges cached ones. The `id` on an `ErrorEvent` can therefore belong to a different event than its title, message and timestamp. Build a `node_id -> event_id` map and iterate `events.items()`, as `bulk_fetch_events` in `delayed_workflow.py:445-459` does.

findings.title: Client `field` param can silently drop or break error context
findings.description:
`process_raw_response(..., fields=request.query_params.getlist("field"))` restricts the replay row to client-requested fields (`post_process.py:101-110`).
- **Silent drop:** a request with `?field=id` removes `error_ids`, so `response[0].get("error_ids", [])` is empty and error context is lost.
- **500:** an unknown field name raises `KeyError`.

Pass `fields=[]` or read `error_ids` directly, since this endpoint does not return the replay row.

Separately, the Snuba query at lines 70-77 runs even when `enable_error_context=false`; the flag check at line 87 should come first.

findings.title: Age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness
findings.description: `validate_timestamp` and `validate_age` test `self.initial_data.get("age")` and `.get("timestamp")` for truthiness. A report with `age: 0` (valid, since `age` has no `min_value`) plus a `timestamp` passes both validators. So does `timestamp: 0` with an `age`. Use `"age" in self.initial_data`. A report with neither field is also accepted; if exactly one is required, that belongs in a serializer-level `validate()`.

findings.title: Browser-report tests no longer cover the `application/reports+json` parser
findings.description: Every `self.client.post(...)` in the rewritten tests dropped `content_type="application/reports+json"`. That is the content type browsers send and the only reason `BrowserReportsJSONParser` exists (`browser_reporting_collector.py:63-69`). Keep at least one happy-path test posting with it.

findings.title: Flex migration drops styles and is applied inconsistently
findings.description:
Several `styled('div')` → `<Flex>` replacements are not style-equivalent:
- **`traceTabsAndVitals.tsx:93`:** the old `Container` extended `FlexBox` (`align-items: center; gap: space(1)`). The replacement keeps only `justify="space-between"`, while `Placeholder` at line 21 keeps all three. The inner `<Flex>` at line 27 also lost `align` and `gap`.
- **`eventAttachments.tsx:143`:** the old `FlexCenter` had `overflowEllipsis` (which sets `overflow: hidden`). Without it the `1fr` grid cell no longer clips, so long attachment names may stop truncating in `Name`.
- **`traceWaterfall.tsx`:** `height: 100%` is dropped and `flex-grow: 1` becomes `flex={1}` (basis `0%`).
- **`instanceLevelOAuthDetails.tsx`:** `width: 100%` is dropped.
- **`integrationLayout.tsx`:** `flex: 1` becomes `Flex.Item grow={1}` (basis `auto` instead of `0`); `flex={1}` would be equivalent.

These need a visual check or the missing props restored.

findings.title: Feature-flagged table path discards the widget's results
findings.description: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is on, `TableWidgetVisualization` is rendered with `columns={[]}` and an empty `tableData`. It ignores `result.data`, `result.meta` and `loading`, so every table widget renders empty. The flag is also not registered anywhere under `src/sentry/features` (grep found only `user-feedback-ai-summaries`), so the branch is currently unreachable. If this is scaffolding, wire the real data or keep the flag check out until it is.

findings.title: `useTraceItemAttributeKeys` rewrite changes caching semantics
findings.description:
- **Query key lacks the org:** the key is `['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions]`, while the request URL uses `organization.slug`. With "all projects" (`project: []`) and the same date range, two orgs share a cache entry.
- **Memoisation defeated:** `projectIds` is a fresh array each render when `projects` is passed, so the `useMemo`s here and the `useCallback` in `useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys` recompute every render.
- **Options dropped:** `staleTime: 0`, `refetchOnWindowFocus: false` and `retry: false` are gone without mention.
- **Loading state:** `isLoading` now maps to `isFetching`, so it flips on background refetches.
- **Return type:** `attributes` can now be `undefined`; the one consumer (`traceItemAttributeContext.tsx:65,74`) tolerates it via spread.
- **Tests:** the new `useGetTraceItemAttributeKeys` hook has no spec of its own.

findings.title: Blanket `except Exception` in `get_environment_info` logged at info
findings.description: Any failure, including programming errors, is swallowed and logged at `info` with the exception object in `extra` and no `exc_info`. Real regressions will show up only as missing environment text. Narrow the exception types or use `logger.warning(..., exc_info=True)`. This also adds one `get_recommended_event()` lookup per issue while building the comment; it is bounded by the top-5 limit, so acceptable.

findings.title: Dead code left behind by the refactors
findings.description:
- **`parameterization.py:335-343`:** the nested `_handle_regex_match` in `parametrize_w_experiments` has no caller now that the regex-experiment branch is gone.
- **`github/integration.py:394` and `gitlab/integration.py:240`:** `format_comment_subtitle` has no remaining callers under `src/`.
- **Explore files:** `const dedupedYAxes = [visualize.yAxis]` followed by `.flatMap`/`.map` over a one-element array remains in `charts/index.tsx:154`, `useAnalytics.tsx:475,496`, `useExploreTimeseries.tsx:179`, `spansTab.tsx:349`, `toolbarSaveAs.tsx:153` and `utils.tsx:439`. Nothing is deduped any more.

findings.title: Owner handling duplicated between `create` and `update`
findings.description: The actor → `owner_user_id`/`owner_team_id` mapping appears at lines 66-79 and again at 120-127. A small helper would keep them in sync. Behaviour is correct and covered by the new endpoint tests.

findings.title: `TableWidgetVisualization` minor robustness points
findings.description:
- **Optional chaining:** `Object.keys(tableData?.meta.fields)` suggests `tableData` may be undefined, but would throw if it were. The prop is required, so drop the `?.`.
- **Fallback condition:** `defaultTableCellRenderers.tsx` falls back on `if (cell)`, so a custom renderer returning `0`, `''` or `null` triggers the default. The docs say only `undefined` does.
- **Cast:** the `as (column: GridColumnOrder, …)` cast at line 107 hides a type mismatch between `TabularColumn` and `GridColumnOrder`.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before the feature gate, with no test
findings.description: `preprod_artifact.api.assemble` is recorded for every request, including those rejected with 404 by the flag check at line 88. That is fine if the intent is to count attempts, but no test asserts the event. `FeedbackSummary` and `useFeedbackSummary` are also added without specs.

findings.title: Delayed-workflow slow-condition hoisting
findings.description: `get_slow_conditions_for_groups` is now computed once and passed to both `get_condition_query_groups` and `get_groups_to_fire`. `dcg_ids` and `dcg_to_groups.keys()` derive from the same `key.dcg_ids` (lines 166-175), so the key set is unchanged. The `event_data` → `workflow_event_data` log fix is correct, and `log_context.get_logger` exists (`utils/log_context.py:71`).

findings.title: Remaining backend changes
findings.description:
- **Migrations:** 0917 and 0920 are now no-ops pointing at 0921, which exists, and no longer import live models.
- **Replay delete:** `_make_recording_filenames` handles `max_segment_id is None`, with the type and test updated.
- **Logs:** `ourlogs.run_top_events_timeseries_query` forwards `equations`, which `rpc_dataset_common` accepts (line 499).
- **Parameterization:** no references to `ParameterizationRegexExperiment` or the `traceparent` option remain in Python sources.

findings.title: Explore `Visualize` single-`yAxis` refactor
findings.description: The remaining `.yAxes` reads under `static/app/views/explore` are on `BaseVisualize`, raw JSON or multi-query types, not on the `Visualize` class. `toJSON` still emits `yAxes: [yAxis]`, so URLs and saved queries keep their format. `AggregateColumnEditorModal` now serialises to `BaseAggregateField[]`, matching its `onColumnsChange` type. `chartActionDropdown.tsx` passes a `referrer` that is in scope.
